'''Projection Relays''' were components used on [[planetary shield generator]]s such as [[CoMar Combat Systems/Legends|CoMar's]] [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator/Legends|SLD-26 model]]. Eight Relays were located within the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] focus dish, evenly spaced and corresponding to one of the generator's shield projectors.<ref name="EGWT" />
